descriptions.cc42b_multiply_matrix_801f6834: Computes the scalar single-precision 4x4 matrix product in original row/column order. The reference compiler reproduces the original fmuls for term one followed by fmadds for terms zero, two and three, with every original indexed load/store and alias behavior retained. Observed float-array layout only; no restrict, fast-math option, extra compiler flag, initialized data or platform-completion claim.
